items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Builds a POST /identities/{id}/snapshots payload (CreateSnapshotRequest) from Rhino geometry for an existing identity. Computes PCA orientation, mesh reduction, stages binary PLY under pending_snapshot_assets/{snapshot_id}/meshes/<i>/.
